d.name: Rowlet
d.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

d.name: Grubbin
d.flavorText: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

d.name: Litten
d.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

d.name: Popplio
d.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

d.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

d.name: Cosmog

attacks.name: Dust Gathering
attacks.text: Draw a card.

d.flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

d.name: Crabrawler
d.flavorText: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

d.name: Alolan Meowth

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

d.name: Alolan Diglett

attacks.name: Spelunk
attacks.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

d.flavorText: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

d.name: Cutiefly

attacks.name: Fly Around
attacks.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

d.flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

d.name: Pikipek

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

d.name: Yungoos
d.flavorText: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

d.name: Caterpie

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

d.name: Metapod

attacks.name: Shed Skin
attacks.text: Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

d.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Bye-Bye Heal
attacks.text: Heal all damage from all of your Pokémon. Shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck.

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

d.name: Oddish

attacks.name: Poison Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

d.name: Gloom

attacks.name: Stinky Scent
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

d.name: Vileplume

abilities.name: Disgusting Pollen
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Basic Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Downer Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

d.name: Tangela

attacks.name: Bind Down
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

d.name: Tangrowth

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Crosswise Whip
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

d.name: Ledyba

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.

d.name: Ledian

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Comet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: While it's believed that starlight provides it with energy, this Pokémon also loves to eat berries. In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.

d.name: Heracross

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.text: If this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

attacks.name: Pitch
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

d.name: Pansage
d.flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

d.name: Simisage

attacks.name: Leaf Supply
attacks.text: You may attach a Grass Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

d.name: Dewpider

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

d.flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

d.name: Araquanid

attacks.name: Bubble Net
attacks.text: Energy can't be attached to the Defending Pokémon from your opponent's hand during their next turn.

d.flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

d.name: Wimpod

abilities.name: Wimp Out
abilities.text: During your first turn, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

d.name: Golisopod-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: First Impression
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was on the Bench and became your Active Pokémon this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Armor Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Crossing Cut-GX
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Charmander
d.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

d.name: Charmeleon
d.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

d.name: Charizard-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Crimson Storm
attacks.text: Discard 3 Fire Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Raging Out-GX
attacks.text: Discard the top 10 cards of your opponent's deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Ho-Oh-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Sacred Fire
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Phoenix Burn
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Phoenix Burn during your next turn.

attacks.name: Eternal Flame-GX
attacks.text: Put 3 in any combination of Fire Pokémon-GX or Fire Pokémon-EX from your discard pile onto your Bench. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Pansear
d.flavorText: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

d.name: Simisear

attacks.name: Flare Recharge
attacks.text: Attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

d.name: Heatmor

attacks.name: Odor Sleuth
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, put a card from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

d.flavorText: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

d.name: Salazzle-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Diabolical Claws
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Prize card you have taken.

attacks.name: Queen's Haze-GX
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Turtonator

attacks.name: Flame Cloak
attacks.text: Attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

d.name: Alolan Vulpix

attacks.name: Powder Snow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

d.name: Alolan Ninetales

abilities.name: Luminous Barrier
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX.

d.flavorText: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

d.name: Horsea

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

d.name: Seadra

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

d.name: Kingdra

attacks.name: Brine
attacks.text: This attack does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Tornado Shot
attacks.text: Discard a Water Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

d.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Splashing Dodge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

d.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Venting Anger
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Magikarp in your discard pile.

attacks.name: Splash Burn
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: A tale is told of a town that angered Gyarados. Before the sun rose the next day, flames utterly consumed the town, leaving not a trace behind.

d.name: Marill

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.

d.name: Azumarill

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from the attacks of your opponent's Fire or Water Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.

d.name: Panpour
d.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

d.name: Simipour

attacks.name: Aqua Reflect
attacks.text: Move a Water Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

d.name: Bruxish

attacks.name: Gnash Teeth
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Synchronoise
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that shares a type with your opponent's Active Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

d.name: Tapu Fini-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Aqua Ring
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hydro Shot
attacks.text: Discard 2 Water Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Tapu Storm-GX
attacks.text: Shuffle your opponent's Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck. If your opponent has no Benched Pokémon, this attack does nothing. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

d.name: Raichu

abilities.name: Evoshock
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Volt Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: It unleashes electric shocks that can reach 100,000 volts. When agitated, it can knock out even an Indian elephant.

d.name: Electabuzz

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.

d.name: Electivire

attacks.name: Thunder Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

d.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.

d.name: Tynamo

attacks.name: Aqua Shock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Water Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage.

d.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

d.name: Eelektrik

attacks.name: Small Appetite
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon's maximum HP is 100 or more, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

d.name: Eelektross

attacks.name: Dark Clamp
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Vacuum Bolt
attacks.text: You may do 80 more damage. If you do, this attack does 80 damage to 1 of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

d.name: Togedemaru

attacks.name: Electrosmash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

d.name: Slowking

attacks.name: Drift Ashore
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Unarmed
attacks.text: If you have no cards in your hand, ignore all Energy in this attack's cost.

d.flavorText: A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.

d.name: Wobbuffet

attacks.name: Shadowy Knot
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

d.flavorText: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

d.name: Seviper

abilities.name: More Poison
abilities.text: Put 1 more damage counter on your opponent's Poisoned Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

d.name: Duskull

attacks.name: Dark Guidance
attacks.text: Put a Basic Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.

d.flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

d.name: Dusclops

attacks.name: Night Roam
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

d.flavorText: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

d.name: Dusknoir

abilities.name: Dark Invitation
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may have your opponent reveal their hand. Put a Basic Pokémon you find there onto your opponent's Bench, and put 3 damage counters on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Jack
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

d.name: Croagunk

attacks.name: Frog Hop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

d.name: Toxicroak

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Poison Boost
attacks.text: If this Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 80 more damage. Then, remove that Special Condition from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

d.name: Venipede

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 40 more damage.

d.flavorText: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

d.name: Whirlipede

attacks.name: Spin Turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

d.name: Scolipede

attacks.name: Poison Horn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Steamroller
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

d.flavorText: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

d.name: Espurr

attacks.name: Perplexing Eyes
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon's Weakness is now Psychic until the end of your next turn. (The amount of Weakness doesn't change.)

d.flavorText: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

d.name: Meowstic

attacks.name: Allure
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Hand Kinesis
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each card in your hand.

d.flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck to dust.

d.name: Sandygast

attacks.name: Absorb Life
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

d.name: Palossand

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Dust Storm
attacks.text: Discard all cards from both Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

d.name: Necrozma-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Light's End
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Colorless Pokémon.

attacks.name: Prismatic Burst
attacks.text: Discard all Psychic Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 60 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Black Ray-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 100 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon-GX and Pokémon-EX. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Machamp-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Bedrock Breaker
attacks.text: Discard any Stadium card in play.

attacks.name: Muscle Punch-GX
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Rhyhorn
d.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

d.name: Rhydon

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Megahorn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

d.name: Rhyperior

abilities.name: Toppling Wind
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Rock Wrecker
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

d.flavorText: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

d.name: Lunatone

abilities.name: Heal Block
abilities.text: If you have Solrock in play, Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) can't be healed.

d.flavorText: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

d.name: Solrock

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Solar Heat
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

d.name: Riolu
d.flavorText: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.

d.name: Lucario

abilities.name: Stance
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.

d.name: Sawk

attacks.name: Quick Guard
attacks.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. This Pokémon can't use Quick Guard during your next turn.

attacks.name: Brick Break
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance or any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

d.name: Crabrawler
d.flavorText: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

d.name: Crabominable

attacks.name: Gutsy Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself for each damage counter on it.

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

d.name: Lycanroc

attacks.name: Dangerous Claws
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: The more intimidating the opponent it faces, the more this Pokémon's blood boils. It will attack with no regard for its own safety.

d.name: Lycanroc
d.flavorText: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

d.name: Mudbray

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

d.name: Mudsdale

attacks.name: Kick Away
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Vigorous Dash
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself. This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

d.name: Passimian

attacks.name: Intentional Grounding
attacks.text: Discard a Pokémon Tool card from your hand. If you don't, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

d.name: Marshadow-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Shadow Hunt
abilities.text: This Pokémon can use the attacks of any Basic Pokémon in your discard pile. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

attacks.name: Peerless Hundred Blows-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage times the amount of basic Energy attached to this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Alolan Rattata

attacks.name: Focus Energy
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Bite attack's base damage is 60.

d.flavorText: With its incisors, it gnaws through doors and infiltrates people's homes. Then, with a twitch of its whiskers, it steals whatever food it finds.

d.name: Alolan Raticate

attacks.name: Enhanced Fang
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 50 more damage.

attacks.name: Hyper Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: It forms a group of Rattata, which it assumes command of. Each group has its own territory, and disputes over food happen often.

d.name: Alolan Grimer

attacks.name: Division
attacks.text: Search your deck for Alolan Grimer and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Slippery Sludge
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a problem with garbage, developed over time into this form.

d.name: Alolan Muk-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Chemical Breath
attacks.text: This attack does 70 more damage for each Special Condition affecting your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tri Hazard-GX
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. The new Active Pokémon is now Burned, Paralyzed, and Poisoned. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Sneasel

attacks.name: Hone Claws
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Slash attack's base damage is 80.

d.flavorText: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

d.name: Weavile

attacks.name: Rule of Evil
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage to each Pokémon that has an Ability (both yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

d.name: Darkrai

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Dark Raid
attacks.text: If your opponent has already used their GX attack, this attack does 80 more damage.

d.flavorText: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

d.name: Darkrai-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Restoration
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may put it onto your Bench. Then, attach a Darkness Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dark Cleave
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Dead End-GX

attacks.name: Constrict
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

d.name: Malamar

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Energy Slosh
attacks.text: You may move all Energy attached to this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

d.name: Ralts

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

d.name: Kirlia
d.flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

d.name: Gardevoir-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Secret Spring
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Fairy Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage times the amount of Energy attached to both Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Twilight-GX
attacks.text: Shuffle 10 cards from your discard pile into your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Diancie

attacks.name: Sparkling Wish
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Diamond Storm
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your Fairy Pokémon.

d.flavorText: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

d.name: Cutiefly
d.flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

d.name: Ribombee

abilities.name: Honey Gather
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

d.name: Morelull
d.flavorText: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

d.name: Shiinotic

attacks.name: Strength Sap
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon 30 damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sleep Pulse
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.flavorText: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

d.name: Noivern-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Distort
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Item cards from their hand during their next turn.

attacks.name: Sonic Volume
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Special Energy cards from their hand during their next turn.

attacks.name: Boomburst-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Zygarde

attacks.name: Core Enforcer
attacks.text: Discard a Darkness Energy and a Fairy Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.

d.name: Meowth

attacks.name: Fake Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.

d.name: Persian

attacks.name: Screech
attacks.text: During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes 60 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: It has a violent temperament. It will attack anything that looks it in the eye. Its sharp claws inflict deep wounds.

d.name: Porygon

attacks.name: Code Check
attacks.text: Look at 1 of your opponent's face-down Prize cards.

d.flavorText: Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.

d.name: Porygon2

attacks.name: Calculate
attacks.text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

d.flavorText: For the purposes of planetary development, Porygon was updated with the most cutting-edge technology available.

d.name: Porygon-Z

abilities.name: Initialize
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may devolve each of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Zap Cannon
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.

d.flavorText: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.

d.name: Hoothoot

attacks.name: See Through
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

d.flavorText: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

d.name: Noctowl

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Night Raid
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. Discard a Pokémon from it.

d.flavorText: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

d.name: Bouffalant

attacks.name: Bouffant Head
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Knock Over
attacks.text: You may discard any Stadium card in play.

d.flavorText: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

d.name: Noibat

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

d.name: Stufful

attacks.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

d.name: Bewear

attacks.name: Mix-Up
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Tantrum
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

abilities.name: Restoration
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may put it onto your Bench. Then, attach a Darkness Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dark Cleave
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Dead End-GX
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, that Pokémon is Knocked Out. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Kirlia
d.flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

d.name: Porygon-Z

abilities.name: Initialize
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may devolve each of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Zap Cannon
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.

d.flavorText: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.

d.name: Acerola
rules: Put 1 of your Pokémon that has any damage counters on it and all cards attached to it into your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Guzma
rules: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. If you do, switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Kiawe
rules: Search your deck for up to 4 Fire Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. Your turn ends.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Bulbasaur
d.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

d.name: Ivysaur

attacks.name: Toxic Whip
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

d.flavorText: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

d.name: Venusaur

abilities.name: Jungle Totem
abilities.text: Each basic Grass Energy attached to your Pokémon provides GrassGrass Energy. You can't apply more than 1 Jungle Totem Ability at a time.

d.flavorText: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.

d.name: Shroomish

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

d.name: Breloom

attacks.name: Hibernation Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. Your opponent flips 2 coins instead of 1 between turns. If either of them is tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep.

d.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

d.name: Carnivine

attacks.name: Flick Poison
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. The new Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

d.name: Shaymin

attacks.name: Flippity Flap
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.

attacks.name: Rally Back
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their last turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

d.flavorText: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

d.name: Virizion

attacks.name: Wrapped in Wind
attacks.text: You may attach a basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pike
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

d.name: Shining Genesect

abilities.name: Energy Reload
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Grass Energy from 1 of your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gaia Blaster
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

d.name: Entei-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Brave Burn-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 150 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Torkoal

attacks.name: High-Pressure Heat
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's High-Pressure Heat attack does 50 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.

d.name: Larvesta
d.flavorText: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

d.name: Volcarona

abilities.name: Heat Cyclone
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may have your opponent switch their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

d.name: Reshiram

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Scorching Breath
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

d.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

d.name: Litten
d.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

d.name: Torracat

attacks.name: Swagger
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

d.name: Incineroar

attacks.name: Profane Punch
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 80 more damage.

attacks.name: Flare Blitz
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

d.name: Totodile
d.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

d.name: Croconaw

abilities.name: Plunge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may move all Energy from your Active Pokémon to this Pokémon. If you do, switch it with your Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

d.name: Feraligatr

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

d.name: Qwilfish

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Shocking Sting
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 50 more damage.

d.flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

d.name: Buizel
d.flavorText: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

d.name: Floatzel

attacks.name: Aqua Bomb
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

d.name: Palkia

attacks.name: Spiral Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

d.name: Manaphy

abilities.name: Blessings of the Deep
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 20 damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has any Water Energy attached to it.

d.flavorText: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

d.name: Keldeo

attacks.name: Bail Out
attacks.text: Put a Water Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Resolute Blade
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

d.name: Shining Volcanion

attacks.name: Dual Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Quad Smash
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

d.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Iron Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

d.name: Raichu-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Powerful Spark
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Lightning Energy attached to your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Voltail-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Voltorb
d.flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

d.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

d.name: Raikou

attacks.name: Booming Thunder
attacks.text: Attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

d.name: Plusle

attacks.name: Tag Team Boost
attacks.text: If Minun is on your Bench, this attack does 50 more damage.

d.flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

d.name: Minun

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

d.name: Zekrom

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Storm Blade
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

d.name: Ekans

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

d.name: Arbok

abilities.name: Intimidating Pattern
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

d.name: Jynx

attacks.name: Whiny Voice
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

attacks.name: Feverish Kiss
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

d.name: Mewtwo-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Full Burst
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage times the amount of Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Super Absorption
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psystrike-GX
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Shining Mew

attacks.name: Legendary Guidance
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

d.name: Latios

attacks.name: Break Through
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

d.name: Shining Jirachi

attacks.name: Stellar Reign
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an evolved Pokémon, devolve it by putting all of the Evolution cards on it into your opponent's hand.

d.flavorText: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

d.name: Golett
d.flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

d.name: Golurk

attacks.name: Triple Smash
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 more damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

d.name: Marshadow

abilities.name: Let Loose
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may have each player shuffle their hand into their deck and draw 4 cards.

attacks.name: Shadow Punch
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

d.flavorText: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

d.name: Stunfisk

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

d.name: Spiritomb

abilities.name: Cursed Whirlpool
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Active Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Cursed Drop
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

d.flavorText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

d.name: Purrloin

attacks.name: Tail Rap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

d.name: Liepard

attacks.name: Torment
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

d.name: Scraggy

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

d.name: Scrafty

attacks.name: Dangerous Head
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.

d.flavorText: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

d.name: Zorua
d.flavorText: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

d.name: Zoroark-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Trade
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a card from your hand. If you do, draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Riotous Beating
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Trickster-GX
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Yveltal

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Oblivion Wing
attacks.text: Attach a Darkness Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

d.name: Hoopa

abilities.name: Scoundrel Guard
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX.

d.flavorText: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

d.name: Shining Rayquaza

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Sky Judgment
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

d.name: Shining Arceus

abilities.name: Fabled Defense
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by your opponent's attacks.

attacks.name: Ultimate Arrow
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.

d.name: Damage Mover
rules: Move 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Energy Retrieval
rules: Put 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Great Ball
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Hau
rules: Draw 3 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Lillie
rules: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. If it's your first turn, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Pokémon Breeder
rules: Draw 2 cards and heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon. If you have no cards in your deck, you can't play this card.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Pokémon Catcher
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Sophocles
rules: Discard 2 cards from your hand. If you do, draw 4 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Super Scoop Up
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your hand.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Switch
rules: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Ultra Ball
rules: Discard 2 cards from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

rules: Double Colorless Energy provides ColorlessColorless Energy.

rules: This card provides Colorless Energy.
