d.name: Weedle

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

d.name: Kakuna

attacks.name: Multiply
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Kakuna and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

d.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Sudden Sting
attacks.text: If this Pokémon evolved from Kakuna during this turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

d.flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

d.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.flavorText: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

d.name: Cacnea

attacks.name: Sucker Punch
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage.

d.flavorText: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

d.name: Cacturne

attacks.name: Spike Rend
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Hunt
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

d.name: Karrablast

abilities.name: Shell On
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Shelmet from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

d.name: Shelmet

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

d.name: Accelgor

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon and heal all damage from it.

d.flavorText: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

d.name: Skiddo
d.flavorText: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

d.name: Gogoat

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.text: This Pokémon's attacks do 80 more damage to your opponent's Grass Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Horn Leech
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

d.name: Alolan Marowak

attacks.name: Dance of Flames
attacks.text: For each Energy attached to your opponent's Pokémon, attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Burning Bonemerang
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads. If either of them is heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

d.flavorText: The bones it possesses were once its mother's. Its mother's regrets have become like a vengeful spirit protecting this Pokémon.

d.name: Numel

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

d.name: Camerupt

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

d.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

d.name: Staryu
d.flavorText: Large numbers of these Pokémon make their home at the seaside. At night, a strange red glow radiates from the center of their bodies.

d.name: Starmie

abilities.name: Escape
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck.

d.flavorText: Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.

d.name: Magikarp

abilities.name: Submerge
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Waterfall Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

d.name: Gyarados-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Draconic Disaster
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 100 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium card.

attacks.name: Dread Storm-GX
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Swinub
d.flavorText: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

d.name: Piloswine

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 90 damage from it.

d.flavorText: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.

d.name: Mamoswine

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Forceful Tackle
attacks.text: You may put up to 9 damage counters on this Pokémon. This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter you placed in this way.

d.flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

d.name: Remoraid
d.flavorText: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

d.name: Octillery

attacks.name: Ink Spit
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Special Artillery
attacks.text: You may discard a Special Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 80 more damage.

d.flavorText: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

d.name: Corphish
d.flavorText: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

d.name: Crawdaunt

attacks.name: Double Claws
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

d.name: Feebas

attacks.name: Splashing Dodge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: A tough Pokémon that is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn't popular.

d.name: Milotic

attacks.name: TLC
attacks.text: Shuffle 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it and all cards attached to it into their deck.

attacks.name: Ocean Cyclone
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

d.name: Regice

abilities.name: Iceberg Shield
abilities.text: If you have Regirock in play, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Stage 2 Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can't be melted, even by magma.

d.name: Shellos

attacks.name: Regeneration
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.

d.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Pika Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

d.name: Alolan Raichu

abilities.name: Surge Surfer
abilities.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It only evolves to this form in the Alola region. According to researchers, its diet is one of the causes of this change.

d.name: Alolan Geodude

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

d.name: Alolan Graveler

attacks.name: Self-Destruct
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 100 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

d.name: Alolan Golem-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Super Electromagnetic Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 50 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Heavy Rock-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any cards from their hand during their next turn. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Emolga

attacks.name: Energy Catch
attacks.text: Put 3 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Volt Switch
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Lightning Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.

d.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Ominous Eyes
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.

d.name: Haunter

attacks.name: Pain Amplifier
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

d.flavorText: It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.

d.name: Gengar

abilities.name: Gnawing Curse
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fade to Black
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.

d.name: Misdreavus

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: It will use any means necessary to frighten people and absorb their life energy. It practices constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.

d.name: Mismagius

attacks.name: Chaos Wheel
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Pokémon Tool, Special Energy, or Stadium cards from their hand during their next turn.

attacks.name: Dark Arts
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each card in your opponent's hand.

d.flavorText: It appears as if from nowhere—muttering incantations, placing curses, and giving people terrifying visions.

d.name: Spoink
d.flavorText: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

d.name: Grumpig

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be Confused.

attacks.name: Psych Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Psych Up attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

d.name: Chimecho

attacks.name: Bell of Silence
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Pokémon that has an Ability from their hand during their next turn.

d.flavorText: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

d.name: Pumpkaboo

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

d.flavorText: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

d.name: Gourgeist

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Pumpkin Bomb
attacks.text: Before doing damage, you may discard any number of Pokémon Tool cards from your Pokémon. This attack does 40 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

d.flavorText: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

d.name: Salandit

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

d.flavorText: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

d.name: Salazzle

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Severe Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 4 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

d.flavorText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

d.name: Oranguru

attacks.name: Fixer of the Forest
attacks.text: Put 3 Pokémon Tool cards from your discard pile into your hand.

d.flavorText: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it's best suited to veteran Trainers.

d.name: Nihilego-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Empty Light
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may leave both Active Pokémon Confused and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Lock Up
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Symbiont-GX
attacks.text: Add the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck to their Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Mankey

attacks.name: Three-Step Strike
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

d.name: Primeape

attacks.name: Lucha Fight
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.

d.name: Cubone

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.

d.name: Regirock

abilities.name: Rock Peak Growl
abilities.text: Your Registeel's attacks do 10 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Tough Swing
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

d.flavorText: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

d.name: Gastrodon

attacks.name: Eerie Fluid
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.

d.name: Stufful
d.flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

d.name: Bewear

abilities.name: Fluffy
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from the attacks of your opponent's non-Fire Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

d.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

d.name: Buzzwole-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Jet Punch
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Knuckle Impact
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Absorption-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each of your remaining Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Houndour
d.flavorText: Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.

d.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Puncturing Fangs
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

d.flavorText: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

d.name: Deino

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

d.name: Zweilous

attacks.name: Double Hit
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

d.name: Hydreigon

abilities.name: Weed Out
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose 3 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, discard your other Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dark Destruction
attacks.text: You may discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

d.name: Guzzlord-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Eat Sloppily
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Glutton-GX
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 2 more Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Guzzlord-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Eat Sloppily
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Glutton-GX
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 2 more Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Mawile

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

d.name: Aron
d.flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

d.name: Lairon
d.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

d.name: Aggron

attacks.name: Revenge Cannon
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Buster Swing
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

d.flavorText: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

d.name: Registeel

attacks.name: Turbo Arm
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Iron Hand
attacks.text: If Regice is on your Bench, heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

d.name: Escavalier

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Iron Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

d.name: Kartana-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Slice Off
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Special Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gale Blade
attacks.text: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck.

attacks.name: Blade-GX
attacks.text: Take a Prize card. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you'll become sleepy right away.

d.name: Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Punishing Slap
attacks.text: If any of your opponent's Pokémon have any Darkness Energy attached to them, this attack does 60 more damage.

d.flavorText: It sheds its fine fur when the seasons change. The fur is gathered and spun into a luxurious yarn.

d.name: Xerneas

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Bright Horns
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Bright Horns during your next turn.

d.flavorText: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

d.name: Alolan Exeggutor-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Tropical Head
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to this Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dragon Hammer
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Tower-Go-Round-GX
attacks.text: Move any number of Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Jangmo-o
d.flavorText: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

d.name: Hakamo-o

attacks.name: Noble Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

d.name: Kommo-o

attacks.name: War Cry
attacks.text: If you have fewer Pokémon in play than your opponent, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Clanging Scales
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

d.name: Miltank

abilities.name: Moomoo Malt
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, heal 90 damage from that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sitdown Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

d.flavorText: Its milk is high in calories and packed with nutrients. Therefore, if you drink too much of it, you may wind up with a body like Miltank's.

d.name: Swablu
d.flavorText: For some reason, it likes to land on people's heads softly and act like it's a hat.

d.name: Altaria

attacks.name: Draco Melody
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Dragon Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Cotton Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

d.name: Starly

attacks.name: Bug Search
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

d.flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

d.name: Staravia
d.flavorText: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

d.name: Staraptor

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Sky Hunting
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by the damage from this attack, switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.

d.name: Regigigas

abilities.name: Seal of Antiquity
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't attack unless Regirock, Regice, and Registeel are on your Bench.

attacks.name: Giant Stomp
attacks.text: Discard any Stadium card in play.

d.flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

d.name: Minccino

attacks.name: Tickle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.

d.name: Cinccino

attacks.name: Amazing Plea
attacks.text: Choose 2 cards from your discard pile. Then, ask your opponent if you may put them into your hand. If yes, put those cards into your hand. If no, this attack does 80 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

d.name: Bunnelby
d.flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

d.name: Diggersby

attacks.name: Dig
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

d.flavorText: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

d.name: Type: Null

attacks.name: Armor Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

d.name: Silvally-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Gyro Unit
abilities.text: Your Basic Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Turbo Drive
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rebel-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Counter Catcher
rules: You can play this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.
Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Dashing Pouch
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
If the Pokémon this card is attached to discards Energy for its Retreat Cost, put that Energy into your hand instead of the discard pile.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Devoured Field
rules: The attacks of Darkness Pokémon and Dragon Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) do 10 more damage to the opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

d.name: Fighting Memory
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
The Silvally-GX this card is attached to is a Fighting Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Gladion
rules: Look at your face-down Prize cards and put 1 of them into your hand. Then, shuffle this Gladion into your remaining Prize cards and put them back face down. If you didn't play this Gladion from your hand, it does nothing.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

attacks.name: Dangerous Stinger
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

d.flavorText: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

d.name: Croagunk

attacks.name: Swagger
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

d.name: Toxicroak

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Exact Revenge
attacks.text: If any of your Fighting Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their last turn, this attack does 70 more damage.

d.flavorText: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

d.name: Giratina ◇
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

abilities.name: Chaotic Star
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may attach 2 Psychic Energy cards from your hand to it.

attacks.name: Crisis Dive
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

d.name: Cresselia

attacks.name: Lunar Payback
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, switch all damage counters on this Pokémon with those on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

d.name: Cosmog

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

d.name: Cosmoem

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

d.name: Lunala ◇
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

attacks.name: Full Moon Star
attacks.text: For each of your opponent's Pokémon in play, attach a Psychic Energy card from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Psystorm
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to all Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Said to live in another world, this Pokémon devours light, drawing the moonless dark veil of night over the brightness of day.

d.name: Dawn Wings Necrozma-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Invasion
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dark Flash
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Moon's Eclipse-GX
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent. Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Cranidos
d.flavorText: In rock layers where Cranidos fossils are found, the fossilized trunks of trees snapped in two are also often found.

d.name: Rampardos

attacks.name: Clean Hit
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Wild Crash
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it is Knocked Out.

d.flavorText: Records exist of a revived fossil that evolved into Rampardos. It proceeded to escape and then destroy a skyscraper with a headbutt.

d.name: Riolu

attacks.name: Detect
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: It's tough enough to run right through the night, and it's also a hard worker, but it's still just a youngster.

d.name: Lucario

abilities.name: Precognitive Aura
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Garchomp in play, you may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Missile Jab
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

d.flavorText: They can detect the species of a living being—and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.

d.name: Hippopotas

attacks.name: Eleventh Hour Tackle
attacks.text: If there are 3 or fewer cards in your deck, this attack does 130 more damage.

d.flavorText: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

d.name: Hippowdon

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Dust Cannon
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

d.flavorText: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

d.name: Passimian

abilities.name: Power Huddle
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, your Passimian's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Evolution Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

d.flavorText: They battle with hard berries for weapons. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.

d.name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Mean Look
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: Seen as a symbol of bad luck, it's generally disliked. Yet it gives presents—objects that sparkle or shine—to Trainers it's close to.

d.name: Honchkrow

attacks.name: Rip and Run
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: If its Murkrow cronies fail to catch food for it, or if it feels they have betrayed it, it will hunt them down wherever they are and punish them.

d.name: Sneasel

attacks.name: Sneaky Smash
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if you go second, and only on your first turn. Discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: It uses its claws to poke holes in eggs so it can slurp out the insides. Breeders consider it a scourge and will drive it away or eradicate it.

d.name: Weavile

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Evil Admonition
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each of your opponent's Pokémon that has an Ability.

d.flavorText: They dwell in cold places. This Pokémon's main food source in Alola is Vulpix and Sandshrew, which they carefully divide among their group.

d.name: Stunky

attacks.name: Gas Bond
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Confused.

d.flavorText: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

d.name: Skuntank

attacks.name: Sticky Smokescreen
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips 2 coins. If either of them is tails, that attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

d.name: Darkrai ◇
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

abilities.name: Nightmare Star
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may attach 2 Darkness Energy cards from your hand to it.

attacks.name: Abyssal Sleep
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. Your opponent flips 2 coins instead of 1 between turns. If either of them is tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep.

d.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

d.name: Alolan Diglett

attacks.name: Iron Head
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: Its golden hairs function as sensors. It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor its surroundings.

d.name: Alolan Dugtrio

attacks.name: Gold Rush
attacks.text: Discard any number of Metal Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 30 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

d.flavorText: These Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

d.name: Magnemite

attacks.name: Searching Magnet
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Metal Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

d.name: Magnemite

abilities.name: Solid Unit
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

d.flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

d.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Zap Cannon
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.

d.flavorText: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

d.name: Magnezone

abilities.name: Magnetic Circuit
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Metal Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Zap Cannon
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.

d.flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

d.name: Shieldon

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. Few enemies would have been willing to square off against its heavily armored face, so it's thought.

d.name: Bastiodon

abilities.name: Earthen Shield
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to your Metal Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy attached to them.

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: You may have your opponent switch their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It lived in the same environments as Rampardos. Their fossils have been found together—seemingly from after they'd fought to the finish.

d.name: Bronzor

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

d.name: Bronzong

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Psychic Resonance
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Psychic Pokémon in play, this attack does 60 more damage.

d.flavorText: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

d.name: Heatran

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Boiling Impact
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

d.name: Solgaleo ◇
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

attacks.name: Radiant Star
attacks.text: For each of your opponent's Pokémon in play, attach a Metal Energy card from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Corona Impact
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to be a male evolution of Cosmog. At the activation of its third eye, it departs for another world.

d.name: Dusk Mane Necrozma-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Meteor Tempest
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sun's Eclipse-GX
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Magearna

abilities.name: Change Clothes
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put a Pokémon Tool card attached to 1 of your Pokémon into your hand.

d.flavorText: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

d.name: Morelull

attacks.name: Flickering Spores
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.flavorText: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

d.name: Shiinotic

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Fairy Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Flickering Spores
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.flavorText: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

d.name: Tapu Lele

attacks.name: Psywave
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Magical Swap
attacks.text: Move any number of damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon to their other Pokémon in any way you like.

d.flavorText: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

d.name: Alolan Exeggutor

attacks.name: Exeggutor's Paradise
attacks.text: For each of your Benched Exeggcute, search your deck for an Alolan Exeggutor or Alolan Exeggutor-GX and put it onto that Exeggcute to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Draco Meteor Barrage
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: Alola is the best environment for this Pokémon. Local people take pride in its appearance, saying this is how Exeggutor ought to look.

d.name: Gible

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

d.name: Gible

abilities.name: Rock Hiding
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Fighting Energy attached to it, it has no Retreat Cost.

d.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

d.name: Gabite

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

d.name: Garchomp

attacks.name: Quick Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Royal Blades
attacks.text: If you played Cynthia from your hand during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage.

d.flavorText: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

d.name: Dialga-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Overclock
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Timeless-GX
attacks.text: Take another turn after this one. (Skip the between-turns step.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Palkia-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Spatial Control
attacks.text: Move any number of Energy from your Benched Pokémon to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hydro Pressure
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Zero Vanish-GX
attacks.text: Shuffle all Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon into their deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Lickitung

attacks.name: Lap Up
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

d.name: Lickilicky

attacks.name: Dangerous Lick
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads. If the first flip is tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Their saliva contains lots of components that can dissolve anything. The numbness caused by their lick does not dissipate.

d.name: Eevee
d.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

d.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Palette of Friends
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each different type of Pokémon on your Bench.

d.flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

d.name: Buneary

attacks.name: Weak Kneed
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.

d.name: Lopunny

attacks.name: Stompy Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Happy Turn
attacks.text: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck.

d.flavorText: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

d.name: Glameow

attacks.name: Gentle Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 40 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

d.name: Purugly

attacks.name: Own the Place
attacks.text: If your opponent has a Stadium card in play, discard it. If you do, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Toss Aside
attacks.text: Discard random cards from your opponent's hand until they have 3 cards in their hand.

d.flavorText: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

d.name: Fan Rotom

abilities.name: Roto Motor
abilities.text: If you have 9 or more Pokémon Tool cards in your discard pile, ignore all Energy in the attack cost of each of this Pokémon's attacks.

attacks.name: Spinning Fan
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

d.name: Shaymin

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

d.name: Yungoos

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses from exhaustion and falls asleep on the spot.

d.name: Gumshoos

attacks.name: Identify
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. If you find a Pokémon there, this attack does 80 more damage.

d.flavorText: It adores having Rattata and Raticate for dinner, but as it's diurnal, it never encounters them. This Pokémon boasts incredible patience.

d.name: Oranguru

attacks.name: Resource Management
attacks.text: Put 3 cards from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck in any order.

attacks.name: Profound Knowledge
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

d.name: Type: Null

attacks.name: Merciless Strike
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 30 more damage.

d.flavorText: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

d.name: Silvally-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Gyro Unit
abilities.text: Your Basic Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Turbo Drive
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rebel-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

d.name: Drampa

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

d.name: Ancient Crystal
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
The Regirock, Regice, Registeel, or Regigigas this card is attached to takes 30 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Cynthia
rules: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Cyrus ◇
rules: You can play this card only if your Active Pokémon is a Water or Metal Pokémon.
Your opponent chooses 2 Benched Pokémon and shuffles the others, and all cards attached to them, into their deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).
◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

d.name: Electric Memory
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
The Silvally-GX this card is attached to is a Lightning Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Escape Board
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is Colorless less, and it can retreat even if it's Asleep or Paralyzed.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Fire Memory
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
The Silvally-GX this card is attached to is a Fire Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Gardenia
rules: Heal 80 damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has any Grass Energy attached to it.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Lillie
rules: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. If it's your first turn, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Looker
rules: Draw 3 cards from the bottom of your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Looker Whistle
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 cards named Looker, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Mars
rules: Draw 2 cards. If you do, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Missing Clover
rules:
You may play 4 Missing Clover cards at once.
• If you played 1 card, look at the top card of your deck.
• If you played 4 cards, take a Prize card. (This effect works one time for 4 cards.)
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Mt. Coronet
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may put 2 Metal Energy cards from their discard pile into their hand.
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

d.name: Order Pad
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Pal Pad
rules: Shuffle 2 Supporter cards from your discard pile into your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Pokémon Fan Club
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Unidentified Fossil
rules: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Colorless Basic Pokémon. At any time during your turn (before your attack), you may discard this card from play.
This card can't retreat.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Volkner
rules: Search your deck for an Item card and a Lightning Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Super Boost Energy ◇
rules: This card provides Colorless Energy.

While this card is attached to a Stage 2 Pokémon, it provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. If you have 3 or more Stage 2 Pokémon in play, it provides every type of Energy but provides 4 Energy at a time.
◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

d.name: Unit Energy GrassFireWater
rules: This card provides Colorless Energy.
While this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Grass, Fire, and Water Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

d.name: Unit Energy LightningPsychicMetal
rules: This card provides Colorless Energy.
While this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Lightning, Psychic, and Metal Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

d.name: Leafeon-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Breath of the Leaves

d.name: Missing Clover
rules:
You may play 4 Missing Clover cards at once.
• If you played 1 card, look at the top card of your deck.
• If you played 4 cards, take a Prize card. (This effect works one time for 4 cards.)
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Multiply
attacks.text: Search your deck for Exeggcute and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Six of them together form a full-fledged Pokémon. It's often hunted by Crabrawler, but uses psychokinesis to drive it off.

d.name: Alolan Exeggutor

attacks.name: Tropical Shake
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each type of basic Energy card in your discard pile. You can't add more than 100 damage in this way.

d.flavorText: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

d.name: Snover

attacks.name: Ice Shard
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Fighting Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.

d.flavorText: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

d.name: Abomasnow

abilities.name: Blessings of the Frost
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may attach a Grass Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hypno Hammer
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.flavorText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

d.name: Scatterbug

abilities.name: Abnormal Outbreak
abilities.text: You can use this Ability only if you go second. Once during your first turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Spewpa and a Vivillon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

d.name: Scatterbug

attacks.name: Ultra Evolution
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for Vivillon and put it onto this Scatterbug to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

d.name: Spewpa

attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

d.name: Vivillon

attacks.name: Vivid Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

d.flavorText: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

d.name: Skiddo

attacks.name: Growth
attacks.text: Attach a Grass Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

d.name: Gogoat

attacks.name: Milk Drink
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

d.name: Pheromosa

attacks.name: White Ray
attacks.text: If you have only 1 Prize card remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

d.flavorText: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

d.name: Alolan Marowak

attacks.name: Limbo Limbo
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Alolan Club
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has Alolan in its name.

d.flavorText: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

d.name: Heatran

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Boiling Impact
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

d.name: Fennekin

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

d.name: Fennekin
d.flavorText: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

d.name: Braixen

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

d.name: Delphox

abilities.name: Mystical Torch
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Burned.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degree Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

d.name: Litleo
d.flavorText: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

d.name: Pyroar

abilities.name: Unnerve
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent plays an Item or Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dominating Fangs
attacks.text: If Lysandre Labs is in play, this attack does 60 more damage.

d.flavorText: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

d.name: Palkia-GX
